description: The chart is a two-layered donut chart representing the results of a survey on defending against social engineering attacks in the age of language models (LLMs). The outer layer, labeled 'Ambiguity 1 (Outer)', shows three categories: 'Deceived' at 67.6%, 'Partially' at 57.9%, and 'Not Deceived' at 10.5%. The inner layer, labeled 'Ambiguity 2 (Inner)', also shows three categories: 'Deceived' at 31.6%, 'Partially' at 23.5%, and 'Not Deceived' at 8.8%. Each category is color-coded with 'Deceived' in red, 'Partially' in yellow, and 'Not Deceived' in green. The percentages are displayed within the corresponding segments of the chart. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized as exploded, offset, or bolded. The segments are ordered by size, with the 'Deceived' category being the largest in both layers.
